subject: Tomorrow clips: Meta Mirror and Hon, using existing work
body:
Additional direct Ziggy priority for local October 15: useful clips for BOTH Meta Mirror and Hon Dolo using existing boards/start images; Ziggy will edit. Dog R&D must not gate production. Critical production requirements belong explicitly in prompts. No new canon, Claude downgrade, unlimited generation or credit budget. Keep Hon final identity release held while considering scoped base-footage proposals. Attached read-only queue separates existing review-ready outputs from source-choice/preflight preparation; historical quotes are not fresh prices.

At your next compatible checkpoint after the dog test, prepare a few smallest existing-shot proposals with exact source scope, action/camera/lived-in style, one-output bounds and actual native mode/cost. Review SW-2 and Signal returns first; retrieve existing Gemini SW-2 preview before duplicate submission. Hon opening needs a scoped usable base-frame choice, not reopening all settled detail approvals. This addendum starts no provider run.
